name: wordpress.publish
description: Publish finished articles to a WordPress site via REST API. Single responsibility tool: takes finished content from AuthorAgent and posts it.
author: BANKON

capabilities.name: publish
capabilities.description: Publish a finished article to WordPress. Use status='future' with a future date for scheduled publishing; WordPress's own cron handles the timer.

capabilities.name: media.upload
capabilities.description: Upload a media file (typically a featured image). Multipart form-data.

capabilities.name: health
capabilities.description: Verify connectivity and authentication against the configured WordPress site.

capabilities.name: post.get
capabilities.description: Read a single post back from WordPress to CONFIRM a publication (authoritative status/link/slug). AuthorAgent calls this after publishing.

capabilities.name: catalogue
capabilities.description: Complete index catalogue of ALL publishings on the target (rage.pythai.net): host, counts-by-status, newest-first post records. Optional ?statuses= comma list (default: all statuses incl. drafts/private, requires auth).

capabilities.name: llms.txt
capabilities.description: Render a deterministic llms.txt ingestion map from the live catalogue (published posts only), per llmstxt.org. The canonical /llms.txt on rage.pythai.net is served by the host plugin; this is the catalogue-derived candidate for diff/handoff.

capabilities.name: llms.txt.report
capabilities.description: Full llms.txt interaction: catalogue + rendered candidate + fetch of the live /llms.txt + diff (missing_from_live / stale_in_live / in_sync).

capabilities.name: soundcloud.embed
capabilities.description: Render SoundCloud audio embed HTML (player iframe + attribution div) for a track or playlist/set, per the SoundCloud WordPress embed flow (help.soundcloud.com/hc/en-us/articles/115003448667). Pure — no auth, no network. Supply one of: album (known key 'takit'|'music4robots2dance2'), playlist_id, track_id, or permalink. Returns the HTML blob ready to drop into post content; the music4robots2dance2 WP plugin and AuthorAgent both consume it.
